title: Shortest closed geodesics on three-dimensional isospectral manifolds
summary: We prove that the spectrum of a smooth closed three-manifold gives a positive lower bound for the length of its shortest nonconstant closed geodesic. The argument uses three curvature heat coefficients and the first positive singularity of the retarded wave trace. The heat coefficients yield a curvature--length dichotomy: sufficiently large maximum curvature forces a closed geodesic shorter than the curvature scale.
